1879060591.name: Shield-blow
1879060591.desc: A strike with your shield that will open a block response.

1879073007.name: Blade Wall
1879073007.desc: Make a frontal AoE attack and reduce your enemies' Physical Mitigation.

1879109231.name: Persevere
1879109231.desc: A shield strike, which heals you over time and increases incoming healing.

1879109615.name: Essence of Flame
1879109615.desc: Fire attack that refreshes Fiery Ridicule on the target.

1879134319.name: Wild Root
1879134319.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879157615.name: Bleeding Arrow
1879157615.desc: A DoT is applied on hit.

1879173359.name: Sable Harvestmath Pony
1879173359.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879191791.name: Sage
1879191791.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Sage.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish. Can be used while in combat.</rgb>

1879193071.name: Guide to Harndirion
1879193071.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Harndirion.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879198319.name: Friend of Sturdy Beasts (Wildpaw-bear)
1879198319.desc: Summons a bear companion.\n\nBears are tough companions which can draw the ire of the enemy.

1879208431.name: White-clad Horse of the Gap
1879208431.desc: A horse bearing a horsehead emblem in white and gold barding.

1879214575.name: Onslaught
1879214575.desc: Multiple fast attacks, dealing direct damage.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879230319.name: Raking Claws
1879230319.desc:
Your claws bite deeply, causing stinging and bleeding wounds.<rgb=#00ff00>
 
 Places a bleed on target. 
 Stacks 3 times. 
 
 Brute Bonus: 
 Places an effect on target that increases Induction times. 
 </rgb>

1879231215.name: Oathbreakers' Bane
1879231215.desc: This medallion will grant you a buff to your damage output and in-combat power regeneration.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>NOTE: This item may only be used at the appropriate time during the Brown Lands instance Lights in the Land.</rgb>

1879240815.name: a mounted melee attack
1879240815.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a two-handed weapon.

1879242095.name: Objective Minded
1879242095.desc: Increase the speed of picking up the Muckle

1879244911.name: Armour of The Elements
1879244911.desc: A thin armour of lightning covers your body. Melee attackers have a chance to be dazed for 5 seconds. Additionally you are protected from an amount of future damage.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Daze replaced with a debuff that reduces damage against dismounted players.</rgb>

1879248367.name: Spread of Arrows - Fire
1879248367.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Fire-based projectiles toward your target.

1879250031.name: Rohan's Edge
1879250031.desc: A powerful attack, further enhanced when landing a critical strike that will cause your next attack to inspire you and your nearby fellowship members.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>After scoring a critical with Rohan's Edge, your next skill-based attack will instantly restore a small amount of power to you, your fellowship members and war-steeds within 40 metres.</rgb>

1879270511.name: Flaming Upshot
1879270511.desc: This attack does additional fire damage for each point of Focus consumed.

1879274095.name: Snap Shot - Improved Hampering Javelin of Light
1879274095.desc: A precise throw can pin a target to the ground and hinder its movement for a short while thereafter.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879303919.name: Fangorn Huorn
1879303919.desc: Summons a Fangorn Huorn to brighten your day.

1879315183.name: Mark of Grimbeorn
1879315183.desc: A mark that can be placed on yourself or an ally. This mark will interact with various skills, altering or increasing their potency.

1879319279.name: Grisly Cry
1879319279.desc: Your roar causes even the staunchest enemies to run in fear.\n\nIf specialized in The Roar, fear will apply to all enemies around the target.

1879391471.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Elvish Squire)
1879391471.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879392111.name: Steed of the Minas Ithil Hero
1879392111.desc: A steed granted to those who braved the trials of the lost city.

1879410031.name: Return to Annâk-khurfu
1879410031.desc: You're able to quickly return to Annâk-khurfu. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879428079.name: Reckless Attack
1879428079.desc: Execute an attack that deals significant damage but leaves yourself open to attack.\nThis skill has a default Critical Damage Multiplier of 2.0 instead of 1.5\nPlaces a mitigation debuff on the Brawler.

1879449839.name: Claw Swipe (Dual)
1879449839.desc: With your claws out, you swing across a group of enemies, lowering their offences for a brief moment.\n\nThis debuff stacks up to 3 times.

1879458543.name: Inspire: Self-determination
1879458543.desc: A melee attack that increases your defences a small amount and greatly increases your damage.

1879467247.name: Toss a Bottle
1879467247.desc: There's nothing like a refreshing bottle of brew to quickly lift the spirits.

1879470575.name: Mounted Pitch Pot
1879470575.desc: A pot filled with boiling pitch.

1879480303.name: Guide to the Bloody Eagle Tavern
1879480303.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to the Bloody Eagle Tavern in Umbar Baharbêl.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879497711.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497711.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879507823.name: Hide in Plain Sight
1879507823.desc: Disappear from before the enemy's eyes.\n\nBriefly improves Stealth. Using this skill will not break Stealth.
